n: University of Alabama at Birmingham ICAC grade 4-5 lesson plans
t: Free grade 4 and 5 lesson plans that bring Scratch into core subjects.
steps: Open the ICAC lesson plans page.
Pick a lesson for your subject and grade.
Open the lesson PDF and any linked Scratch project.
Check the standards note on the lesson.
Check which accounts the linked tools need. The page does not say.
Try the lesson yourself before class.
